   - The coordinates of \( B \) and \( C \) are \( \left( \frac{l}{2}, \frac{l\sqrt{3}}{2} \right) \) and \( \left( d - \frac{l}{2}, \frac{l\sqrt{3}}{2} \right) \) respectively, where \( l \) is the length of the legs.

2. **Using Diagonal Lengths:**
   - The length of the diagonals \( AC \) and \( BD \) is \( 10\sqrt{21} \).

     \[
